title: Bảo tàng và phí vào cửa · Discuss both views
prompt: Some people support charging admission to publicly funded museums, while others oppose it because of the risks it could create. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
instructions: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.

outline.purpose: Dạng discuss yêu cầu giải thích riêng vì sao mỗi phía tin lập trường của mình rồi đưa phán đoán của người viết. Trong bài này, cân nhắc trọng tâm là: Bảo quản hiện vật cần nhân lực chuyên môn dù bảo tàng có giá trị công ích. Vé tài trợ một đầu vào thật, nhưng không chứng minh mọi khách phải trả cùng mức. Giờ miễn và ưu đãi giữ cơ hội học, nhưng phải đủ thuận tiện để dùng. Cần xét bảo tàng vừa nhận thuế vừa thu phí có đang cản người đáng được hưởng dịch vụ công không.
outline.content: Supporters argue that admission revenue can support conservation and visitor services. Opponents respond that fees can discourage repeated visits by local families with limited disposable income. I accept supporters' case for conservation revenue, but consider opponents' access concerns decisive in setting prices and free periods, since public collections must remain available for repeated local learning.

paragraphs: Supporters argue that admission revenue can support conservation and visitor services. Opponents respond that fees can discourage repeated visits by local families with limited disposable income. I accept supporters' case for conservation revenue, but consider opponents' access concerns decisive in setting prices and free periods, since public collections must remain available for repeated local learning.

Admission revenue can support conservation and visitor services. Preserving fragile collections requires specialist work even when a museum's public value is widely recognised. Ticket income could help restore an object that cannot safely remain on display. Specialist conservation can be expensive even when visitor numbers are modest, so a reliable income source may protect collections that cannot finance themselves commercially. Conservation requires resources, but an admission charge may deter repeat visits by local families even when a single visit by an occasional tourist remains affordable.

Fees can discourage repeated visits by local families with limited disposable income. A fee that appears modest for an occasional holiday visit becomes a repeated expense for local households using a museum for regular learning. Those families may reduce attendance, so raising conservation income can simultaneously narrow participation in a publicly supported educational resource. Free access periods and targeted concessions should preserve educational access. Free periods and concessions need convenient times and simple eligibility, since nominal access means little if the intended users cannot realistically attend. The balance should be judged through conservation quality, net revenue and educational access, with concessions that are usable rather than merely advertised.

Supporters explain why collections require revenue, while opponents explain why identical charges can be exclusionary; modest fees with usable concessions better serve public museums than treating either income or attendance as the sole objective.

A fee that appears modest for an occasional holiday visit becomes a repeated expense for local households using a museum for regular learning. Those families may reduce attendance, so raising conservation income can simultaneously narrow participation in a publicly supported educational resource. Free access periods and targeted concessions should preserve educational access. Free periods and concessions need convenient times and simple eligibility, since nominal access means little if the intended users cannot realistically attend. The balance should be judged through conservation quality, net revenue and educational access, with concessions that are usable rather than merely advertised.
paragraphs.why: Giờ miễn và ưu đãi giữ cơ hội học, nhưng phải đủ thuận tiện để dùng. Cần xét bảo tàng vừa nhận thuế vừa thu phí có đang cản người đáng được hưởng dịch vụ công không.
